title: Spaceship Hosting Review 2026: Prices, Speed Tests, Promo Codes and AI Builder
excerpt: Spaceship hosting starts at $19.88 for the first year with a 30-day free trial. Here is the three-year cost, how it tested, which promo codes are real and what costs extra.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Spaceship Hosting Review 2026: Prices, Speed, Promo Code
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Spaceship hosting review for 2026: plan prices and three-year cost, speed and uptime from independent tests, promo codes, extras that cost more, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Spaceship hosting is very cheap and fast for US visitors, with 99.992% uptime in a 90-day test. Backups are priced separately, there is no phone support, and renewals are 1.45 to 1.77 times the first year.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Spaceship hosting good? | Yes for small sites near the US. SimonHosting measured 99.992% uptime over 90 days and a 242 ms time to first byte.
How much does Spaceship hosting cost? | Essential is $19.88 for the first year and $28.88 a year at renewal. Pro is $28.88 then $48.88. Supreme is $38.88 then $68.88.
Is there a Spaceship promo code? | Its sale page lists COM67 for a .com at $3.60, NET19 for .net and IO85 for .io, for new registrations.
Does Spaceship have a free trial? | Yes. Every shared plan starts with a 30-day free trial.
How fast is Spaceship? | SimonHosting measured a 242 ms time to first byte and a 1.4 second Largest Contentful Paint. Prehost's real-user median is 1.1 seconds.
Does Spaceship have phone support? | No, according to SimonHosting.
Does Spaceship include email and backups? | Essential lists 5 free mailboxes per domain, and Pro and Supreme list 25 free mailboxes for one year. AutoBackup is listed as a separate feature, with TechRadar reporting backups from $11.76 for 5 GB on a two-year plan.
Is Spaceship the same as Namecheap? | No, but DevProblems says it is built on Namecheap's foundation, and TechRadar found near-identical server performance.
Does Spaceship have an AI website builder? | Yes. It lists an AI website builder and WordPress AI tools on all plans, plus MCP access for AI agents.
Is Spaceship reliable? | It lists a 99.99% guarantee. SimonHosting measured 99.992% and Scribeage 100%.
Does Spaceship have a money-back guarantee? | We did not find one on the page we read. It offers a 30-day free trial.
Who should avoid Spaceship? | People who need phone support, want backups included, or want a long-established host.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Essential is $19.88 for the first year and renews at $28.88.
SimonHosting measured 99.992% uptime over 90 days and a 242 ms time to first byte.
Backups are priced separately, and there is no phone support.
COM67 gives a .com for $3.60, for new registrations only.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Spaceship is one of the cheapest, fastest starts for a small site near the US. Uptime was strong in two tests. Budget for backups, and expect chat support only.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You want a very low first-year price and a free 30-day trial.
You want domains, hosting and email in one dashboard.
Most of your visitors are in the US.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You need phone support.
You want backups included in the price.
You want a long-established host.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Very low prices from $1.66 a month.
A 30-day free trial.
Fast US speeds and strong uptime in independent tests.
Imunify360 security and an AI website builder included.
Renewals jump less than at most hosts.
meta.rl_r_cons:
Backups are priced separately.
No phone support.
No stated compensation for the uptime guarantee.
A newer company.
Stricter fraud checks on new accounts.
meta.rl_r_best: Small sites near the US on a small budget
